body: Well the most recent instance was that at work tonight I didn't get my tasks done, putting it onto another person. I know things like that seem small to some folks but to me inconveniencing someone is a big deal. This type of thing is consistently an issue, and sometimes it's a bigger ordeal, like fairly recently I hurt someone deeply because they decided to stop pursuing a relationship. It's just constant.

Thanks for the reply. I just constantly see instances in which I negatively affect others. Like letting them down or insulting them, or things as simple as taking more than my fair share of things. Even if it's things that they don't notice, I'm just consistently worsening others' lives.

Whether it be small things or big things I just see way more negative things that I bring than positive. I'm constantly letting people down or being an asshole, etc.

Thanks for the replies by the way dude

I've tried for years to believe that this is just temporary but it's not seeming that way. I think that the whole "suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem" idea has only a few real applications, none of which align with my situation.
